[[Category:BITwiki Schema Matter]]


= BITwiki Property Types: SMW Data Types and Constraints =

== Etymology: The Shapes of Data ==

''Type'' — from Greek ''typos'', impression, figure, model. In data, a type is the shape that values take—the pattern that distinguishes text from number, date from location.

''Property'' — from Latin ''proprietas'', that which is proper, characteristic. A property type is the characteristic form of a characteristic—the way that attributes show up in the knowledge field.

== Purpose: Types as Enabling Constraints ==

This document describes property types used in BITwiki's Semantic MediaWiki implementation. Types are not prisons but foundations—they enable queries, ensure consistency, and facilitate exchange.

Types serve:
* '''Validation''': Checking that values match expected forms
* '''Query''': Enabling comparisons and filters
* '''Display''': Formatting values appropriately
* '''Export''': Facilitating data exchange

They constrain only to enable. They are provisional, subject to extension.

== Core Property Types: Foundational Forms ==

=== Text ===

'''Definition:''' Plain text strings.

'''Usage:''' Names, descriptions, definitions.

'''SMW:'''
```wiki
[[Has type::Text]]
```

'''Examples:'''
```wiki
[[Has name::Feedback Loop]]
[[Has description::A process where outputs are fed back as inputs]]
```

'''Characteristics:'''
* Flexible content
* Unicode supported
* No fixed length
* Maximum length: 255 characters (default)
* No markup (unless specified)

'''Constraints:'''
* Maximum length: 255 characters (default)
* No markup (unless specified)
* Unicode supported

=== Number ===

'''Definition:''' Numeric values (integers or decimals).

'''Usage:''' Counts, measurements, quantitative assessments, confidence scores.

'''SMW:'''
```wiki
[[Has type::Number]]
```

'''Examples:'''
```wiki
[[Has evidence count::12]]
[[Has temperature::23.5]]
[[Has confidence score::0.85]]
[[Has source count::10]]
```

'''Characteristics:'''
* Supports arithmetic
* Decimal precision configurable
* Units can be specified
* Range: -∞ to +∞
* Decimal precision: configurable
* Units: optional

'''Constraints:'''
* Range: -∞ to +∞
* Decimal precision: configurable
* Units: optional

=== Date ===

'''Definition:''' Calendar dates and times.

'''Usage:''' Origin dates, validation dates, timelines.

'''SMW:'''
```wiki
[[Has type::Date]]
```

'''Examples:'''
```wiki
[[Has origin date::1948]]
[[Has validation date::2026-02-12]]
```

'''Characteristics:'''
* ISO 8601 format
* Range from historical to future
* Timezone awareness
* Format: ISO 8601
* Range: historical to future
* Timezone: UTC default

'''Constraints:'''
* Format: ISO 8601
* Range: historical to future
* Timezone: UTC default

=== Page ===

'''Definition:''' References to other wiki pages.

'''Usage:''' Relationships, categorization, linking.

'''SMW:'''
```wiki
[[Has type::Page]]
```

'''Examples:'''
```wiki
[[Has originator::Person:Norbert Wiener]]
[[Has related::Idea:Homeostasis]]
```

'''Characteristics:'''
* Creates bidirectional links
* Namespace flexible
* Inverse relationships configurable
* Must exist (optional)
* Namespace: any
* Inverse: configurable

'''Constraints:'''
* Must exist (optional)
* Namespace: any
* Inverse: configurable

=== Boolean ===

'''Definition:''' True/false values.

'''Usage:''' Flags, status indicators.

'''SMW:'''
```wiki
[[Has type::Boolean]]
```

'''Examples:'''
```wiki
[[Has constitutional status::true]]
[[Has validation required::false]]
```

'''Characteristics:'''
* Binary values
* Default handling
* Logical operations
* Values: true/false, yes/no, 1/0
* Default: false

'''Constraints:'''
* Values: true/false, yes/no, 1/0
* Default: false

=== URL ===

'''Definition:''' Web addresses.

'''Usage:''' External links, references.

'''SMW:'''
```wiki
[[Has type::URL]]
```

'''Examples:'''
```wiki
[[Has source URL::https://example.com/paper]]
[[Has DOI::https://doi.org/10.xxxx/xxxxx]]
```

'''Characteristics:'''
* Link validation
* Protocol flexibility
* Clickable output
* Must be valid URL format
* Protocol: http/https/ftp/etc.

'''Constraints:'''
* Must be valid URL format
* Protocol: http/https/ftp/etc.

== Specialized Property Types: Extended Forms ==

=== Email ===

'''Definition:''' Email addresses.

'''Usage:''' Contact information.

'''SMW:'''
```wiki
[[Has type::Email]]
```

'''Characteristics:'''
* Format validation
* Clickable mailto links
* Domain checking optional
* Must be valid email format
* Domain validation: optional

'''Constraints:'''
* Must be valid email format
* Domain validation: optional

=== Telephone ===

'''Definition:''' Phone numbers.

'''Usage:''' Contact information.

'''SMW:'''
```wiki
[[Has type::Telephone number]]
```

'''Characteristics:'''
* International format
* Country code support
* Clickable dial links
* Format: international
* Country code: required

'''Constraints:'''
* Format: international
* Country code: required

=== Geographic Coordinate ===

'''Definition:''' Latitude and longitude.

'''Usage:''' Location data.

'''SMW:'''
```wiki
[[Has type::Geographic coordinate]]
```

'''Example:'''
```wiki
[[Has coordinates::42.3601,-71.0589]]
```

'''Characteristics:'''
* Map integration
* Distance calculations
* Range validation
* Latitude: -90 to +90
* Longitude: -180 to +180

'''Constraints:'''
* Latitude: -90 to +90
* Longitude: -180 to +180

=== Temperature ===

'''Definition:''' Temperature values.

'''Usage:''' Scientific measurements.

'''SMW:'''
```wiki
[[Has type::Temperature]]
```

'''Characteristics:'''
* Unit conversion
* Range validation
* Scientific notation
* Units: Celsius, Fahrenheit, Kelvin
* Range: absolute zero to infinity

'''Constraints:'''
* Units: Celsius, Fahrenheit, Kelvin
* Range: absolute zero to infinity

== Property Constraints: Guidelines for Consistency ==

=== Cardinality ===

'''Single Value:''' One value per property per page.
```wiki
[[Has type::Text]]
[[Has cardinality::Single]]
```

'''Multiple Values:''' Many values allowed.
```wiki
[[Has type::Page]]
[[Has cardinality::Multiple]]
```

=== Range ===

'''Numeric Range:''' Minimum and maximum values.
```wiki
[[Has type::Number]]
[[Has minimum value::0]]
[[Has maximum value::100]]
```

'''Date Range:''' Temporal boundaries.
```wiki
[[Has type::Date]]
[[Has minimum date::1900]]
[[Has maximum date::2100]]
```

=== Allowed Values ===

'''Enumeration:''' Specific allowed values.
```wiki
[[Has type::Text]]
[[Has allowed value::Hypothetical]]
[[Has allowed value::Emerging]]
[[Has allowed value::Established]]
[[Has allowed value::Verified]]
[[Has allowed value::Axiomatic]]
```

== Validation: Ensuring Integrity ==

=== Type Validation ===
* Property value must match declared type
* Type coercion: configurable
* Invalid values: flagged

=== Constraint Validation ===
* Cardinality: enforced
* Range: enforced
* Allowed values: enforced

=== Error Handling ===

'''Invalid Type:'''
```wiki
[[Category:Property type error]]
```

'''Constraint Violation:'''
```wiki
[[Category:Constraint violation]]
```

== SMW Queries: Discovering by Type ==

=== By Type ===

All text properties:
```wiki
{{#ask: [[Has type::Text]]}}
```

All numeric properties:
```wiki
{{#ask: [[Has type::Number]]}}
```

=== By Constraint ===

Single cardinality:
```wiki
{{#ask: [[Has cardinality::Single]]}}
```

With range:
```wiki
{{#ask: [[Has minimum value::+]]}}
```

== Property Metadata ==

The following properties can be used to annotate property definitions themselves:
* `[[Has confidence score::0.87]]` — Quantitative confidence assessment
* `[[Has confidence trajectory::established]]` — Qualitative confidence trajectory
* `[[Has property type count::10]]` — Count of property types defined
* `[[Has source count::10]]` — Number of reference sources
* `[[Has word count::500]]` — Document word count estimate

== References ==

# W3C. (2014). RDF Schema 1.1.
# OWL 2 Web Ontology Language. (2012).
# XML Schema Datatypes. (2004).
# BITwiki Ontology Index. (2026).
# BITwiki Constitution. (2026).
# Gruber, T.R. (1993). A translation approach to portable ontology specifications.
# Smith, B. (2003). Ontology.
# Noy, N.F., & McGuinness, D.L. (2001). Ontology development 101.
# Sowa, J.F. (2000). Knowledge Representation.

[[Has epistemic tier::Established]]
[[Has confidence score::0.87]]
[[Has confidence trajectory::established]]
[[Has property type count::10]]
[[Has source count::10]]
[[Has word count::500]]
